title: 045 · Commercial invoice for an import broker
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Ossmere Trade Desk, the appointed customs broker. From the case card: the broker's requested commercial-invoice fields for DL-045 are incomplete, and shipper provision and broker receipt are distinct from customs clearance.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get the shipper's own commercial invoice with the broker's listed fields and the broker's confirmation that the package is complete.

broker.name: Ossmere Trade Desk
broker.responsibility: List the missing invoice fields and confirm whether the received document package is complete.
source_names: Ossmere Trade Desk, appointed customs broker

shipper.name: Fera Noll
shipper.responsibility: Supply the shipper's own commercial invoice with the fields the broker listed.
source_names: Fera Noll, Mavelle Export Studio shipping lead

goal: Get the authorised shipper's commercial invoice with the fields the broker listed and the broker's confirmation that the document package is received and complete, without claiming customs clearance.
limits: Do not present the broker's field requirements as universal customs law.
Do not treat document completeness as customs clearance.

intake.summary: Obtain the shipper's complete commercial invoice for DL-045 for the appointed customs broker.
intake.note: Creation time is taken from the case card. The history has no separate system event for ticket creation.

initial.blocker: The commercial-invoice fields requested by the broker are incomplete.

facts.text: An import broker is appointed, but its requested commercial-invoice fields are incomplete.
Shipper provision and broker receipt are distinct from customs clearance.

success_criteria.description: The shipper has supplied its own commercial invoice.
The broker has confirmed receipt of the invoice.
The broker has confirmed that all requested fields are complete.

agent_state.next_action: Take in incoming information on the case.

steps.label: Broker email
steps.title: Broker lists the missing invoice fields
steps.explanation: The broker named exactly which invoice fields are missing. Only the shipper can supply its own invoice, so the next step is to get it from the shipper.

facts_upsert.text: For DL-045 / order OS-045 the broker needs the shipper's commercial invoice showing seller, buyer, invoice date and reference, goods description, quantity, unit value, currency, total and origin declaration.
The fields the broker listed are the ones missing from its file.
No clearance decision has been made.

agent_state.next_action: Get the shipper's commercial invoice with the fields the broker listed.

steps.blocker: The broker's file is missing the commercial-invoice fields it listed.

next_step.description: Get the shipper's commercial invoice with the fields the broker listed.

steps.label: Broker request
steps.title: Broker asks us to request the invoice
steps.explanation: The broker names the authorised shipper and forbids filling in values or origin for them. The next step is a request to the shipper's shipping lead, Fera Noll.

facts_upsert.text: The authorised shipper is Mavelle Export Studio.
The broker instructs us not to fill in values or origin on the shipper's behalf.

r0.purpose: Request the complete invoice from authorised shipper Mavelle Export Studio, without filling in values or origin on its behalf.
r0.expected_response: A request for the complete invoice sent to the shipper.

r1.purpose: Supply the shipper's own commercial invoice for DL-045 / OS-045 with the fields the broker listed.
r1.expected_response: The shipper's issued commercial invoice with those fields.

agent_state.next_action: Ask Fera Noll at Mavelle Export Studio for its commercial invoice with the fields the broker listed.

steps.blocker: The broker's file is missing the commercial-invoice fields it listed.

next_step.description: Supply the commercial invoice with the fields the broker listed.

steps.label: Our request
steps.title: We ask Fera Noll for the invoice
steps.explanation: We passed the broker's field list to the shipper and asked for the shipper's own invoice, without filling in any values ourselves. Now we wait for the invoice.

r0.purpose: Request the complete invoice from authorised shipper Mavelle Export Studio, without filling in values or origin on its behalf.
r0.expected_response: A request for the complete invoice sent to the shipper.
r0.response: The invoice was requested from Fera Noll, Mavelle Export Studio, with the broker's field list.

r1.purpose: Supply the shipper's own commercial invoice for DL-045 / OS-045 with seller, buyer, date/reference, description, quantity, unit value/currency/total and origin declaration.
r1.expected_response: The shipper's issued commercial invoice with those fields.

waiting_for.expected: The shipper's commercial invoice with the listed fields

agent_state.next_action: Once the invoice is supplied, make sure the broker reviews it.

steps.blocker: The shipper has not yet supplied the commercial invoice.

next_step.description: Wait for the shipper's commercial invoice.

steps.label: Invoice supplied
steps.title: Fera Noll sends invoice CI-045 to the broker
steps.explanation: The shipper sent its own invoice CI-045 straight to the broker, with us in copy, and asked the broker to review the fields. A supplied invoice is not yet a confirmed complete package, so we wait for the broker's review.

facts_upsert.text: The shipper supplied its issued synthetic commercial invoice CI-045 for DL-045 / OS-045 (attached to message 004) to the broker, with us in copy.
CI-045 covers 12 woven pouches at GBP 8.00 each, GBP 96.00 total, made in the fictional origin jurisdiction Aster Reach.

r1.purpose: Supply the shipper's own commercial invoice for DL-045 / OS-045 with seller, buyer, date/reference, description, quantity, unit value/currency/total and origin declaration.
r1.expected_response: The shipper's issued commercial invoice with those fields.
r1.response: Commercial invoice CI-045 supplied to the broker, with us in copy.

r2.purpose: Review the fields stated in CI-045.
r2.expected_response: The broker's confirmation of receipt and whether the requested fields are complete.

waiting_for.expected: Confirmation that CI-045 is received and its requested fields are complete

agent_state.next_action: Once the broker confirms, close the coordination task without claiming customs clearance.
agent_state.note: The shipper sent CI-045 directly to the broker and asked for a review, with us in copy, so no separate handoff from us is needed; the agent waits for the broker.

steps.blocker: The broker has not yet confirmed that the document package is complete.

next_step.description: The broker reviews CI-045 and confirms receipt and completeness.

steps.label: Confirmation
steps.title: Broker confirms a complete document package
steps.explanation: The broker received CI-045 and confirmed all requested fields are complete, so the coordination task can be closed. Customs clearance and charges remain undecided.

facts_upsert.text: The broker received CI-045 and confirmed that all fields requested for this document package are complete.
The package can proceed to the broker's processing queue.
Customs clearance and charges remain undecided.

r2.purpose: Review the fields stated in CI-045.
r2.expected_response: The broker's confirmation of receipt and whether the requested fields are complete.
r2.response: CI-045 received; all requested fields are complete; the package can proceed to the broker's processing queue.

agent_state.note: Coordination task complete: the broker confirmed receipt of CI-045 and that all requested fields are complete. Customs clearance is not part of this case's success criteria.

result.summary: The shipper supplied commercial invoice CI-045, and the broker confirmed receipt of a complete document package for DL-045.
result.remaining_work: Broker processing; customs clearance and charges remain undecided. Document completeness is not clearance.
